clips.title: The story
paras: Oben Rageclaw lies asleep in Ban'ethil Barrow Den, but his spirit is caught in the Emerald Dream. Gnarlpine shamans have drawn it from his body and set his flesh moving through the den.

Night elf druids sleep in barrow dens across Kalimdor while their spirits wander the Emerald Dream. Their bodies rest in stone alcoves, safe through centuries of slumber. Teldrassil's corruption has driven the Gnarlpine furbolgs to desperate savagery. In Ban'ethil Barrow Den, Gnarlpine shamans found a way to breach Oben Rageclaw's sacred rest and draw his living spirit from his sleeping body.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Gnarlpine shaman that inhabit this place have discovered a way of separating a sleeping druid's spirit from the physical body. The furbolg have animated my physical form and are using it to attack anyone that attempts to explore the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. I am now trapped in the Emerald Dream, powerless to stop this.
You must help me. The Gnarlpine shaman carry a strange charm which is used to perform this ritual, and I'd like to examine it. Please, friend, bring one to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If I can examine the charm, I may be able to figure out how to break the enchantment. Have you found one?

clips.title: Completion
paras: What an odd trinket this is... I can sense the vile aura emanating from it; this is a very powerful enchantment.
